All APIs verified against installed polars 1.42.1 via LCP.

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "user": ["alice", "bob", "carol", "dave"],
        "amount": [50, 150, 200, 80],
    }
)

lazy_query = df.lazy().filter(pl.col("amount") > 100).select("user")

result = lazy_query.collect()
print(result)
```
